prompt:
Using the provided reference poster as the base, create a sister “Good Morning” city poster for Kunming instead of Beijing while preserving the same vertical vintage editorial layout, aged paper texture, ink gaps, halftone dot erosion, thin border grime, small issue/page metadata blocks, diagonal hairline, bottom quote placement, and calm morning atmosphere.

Transform the main city typography: replace the giant central Chinese characters with 昆明, rendered as oversized blocky orange-yellow letterpress shapes with distressed edges and visible halftone speckling. Update the small top-left location label to “KUNMING,” the weather line to WEATHER 晴 / 云淡, and keep the date format as 2026-08-07. Update the bottom-right location box to “KUNMING, CHINA,” and adjust the city index coordinates to match Kunming.

Replace the Beijing wall-and-cyclist scene with a tranquil Kunming waterfront promenade: add exactly 1 walking pedestrian in front of the large characters, exactly 1 tall streetlamp at the left, a row of short stone bollards connected along the water’s edge, exactly 3 small flying birds near the left side of the typography, a calm lake in the foreground with soft reflections, and on the right add a small traditional pavilion beside pale pink flowering trees. Keep the composition sparse with large empty paper space above.

Use a muted warm ochre palette for the typography instead of the deeper red-orange in the reference, with blue-green gray water and delicate faded ink printing. Maintain the same nostalgic Chinese magazine-cover / travel-poster aesthetic, including worn ink, misregistration, rough paper grain, and subtle stains.

Bottom quote text: “四季如春，也要日日新鲜”. Avoid adding any extra modern objects, logos, or unnecessary text.
